     ORAL ARGUMENT OF SOPAN JOSHI
 ON BEHALF OF THE PETITIONERS
 MR. JOSHI: Mr. Chief Justice, and may
it please the Court:
 A permit application is not final
agency action. It's a request to someone else
 to take action. Filing a permit application
 triggers a back-and-forth process whose outcome
is, by definition, a moving target until a
 decision on the permit is issued.  Treating an
application as final would just lead to a
 multiplicity of suits throughout a permitting
process, which I think defeats the whole point
 of the finality requirement.
 Now Respondent says that the
 application reflects some internal Air Force
decision to continue these activities for the
next three years if Guam issues a permit. But
